$schema-note: Hand-rolled strict subset (no jsonschema dependency, per DEPENDENCY RULES). Validated per line by tools/xr_schema.py (validate_document) through tools/permission_contract_check.py, because the golden is JSON Lines. additionalProperties is false everywhere. ABSENCE LAWS: NO usage, quota, or active-count field of any kind (the schema has no property for them, so a planted one is rejected); NO free-text origin (a bare registrable domain or the empty string for identity-wide rows: the bare-domain rule is enforced by the C++ generator, RedactOrigin, and by the Python contract check, since this validator has no pattern keyword). Generator: xr-core/permissions/core/audit.cc (golden bytes tested in xr-core/permissions/tests/test_audit.cc).

determinism_note.const: ts_millis is caller-supplied; the core reads no clock; identical inputs give identical bytes
